accounting_explanation: The current-period ShortTermBorrowings tag is unavailable/stale. DebtCurrent at 2026-10-24 is 10,425,000,000 and includes the current portion of long-term debt of 2,001,000,000 plus short-term borrowings. Subtracting LongTermDebtCurrent from DebtCurrent gives 8,424,000,000, which the debt note identifies as commercial paper. Therefore the production short-term-borrowings value of 0 is not supported; the current short-term borrowings component should be 8,424,000,000.
